On [[Big Brother 21 (US)|''Big Brother 21'' (US)]], Nicole was known for her kindness, quirkiness, and her relationships with [[Kemi Fakunle]], [[Ovi Kabir]] and [[Cliff Hogg III|Cliff Hogg III.]] Although she remained under the radar for most of the game, Nicole was a savvy social player, managing to flip the vote, and survived an eviction by a 6-4 vote in week 3 after being publicly ostracized by the controlling alliance, [[Unde9able]]. During the [[Unde9able]] reign, she was their main bullying target; unable to get in any of their conversations. Many viewers thought this was unfair bullying to Nicole. As the game progressed, Nicole and her main ally, Cliff, found themselves in a good position after the [[Gr8ful]] alliance broke up. They later formed a final four alliance with [[Jackson Michie]] and [[Holly Allen]]. In the middle part of the game, Nicole found herself as the deciding vote on several occasions. At the [[Double Eviction]], Nicole won her first [[Head of Household]] and made the move to evict power player, [[Christie Murphy]]. After saving Cliff with the [[Power of Veto]] at the final five, Nicole and Cliff chose to evict [[Tommy Bracco]] over Holly, after Jackson was able to falsely convince Cliff and Nicole that Tommy was targeting them. Despite winning HoH at the final 4, Jackson evicted Cliff after winning the Power of Veto. Nicole was unable to win Part 1 or Part 2 of the final Head of Household competition. She was evicted by Jackson, finishing in 3rd place, leaving her the 9th and final member of [[the jury]]. On Finale Night, Nicole's personality, kindness, and growth throughout the game made her a beloved fan favorite which resulted in her winning [[America's Favorite Houseguest]]. Nicole returned the following season for [[Big Brother 22 (US)|''Big Brother 22'' (US)]]. She initially tried to connect with [[Janelle Pierzina]] and [[Kaysar Ridha]]; however, after being placed on the block the second week by their ally, [[Memphis Garrett]], she lost trust with Janelle and Kaysar. This spiraled into Nicole campaigning that she would go after the duo the following week. Though she later found out she was wrong about everything, it was too little too late. She was evicted that week in a 10-2 vote against fellow ''Big Brother 21 (US)'' castmate [[David Alexander]], placing 15th.
